description: Principle asserting that once an artifact is compiled and tested, its binary contents must never be modified or rebuilt.
Immutable 256-bit cryptographic hash uniquely identifying the exact binary contents of an artifact.
Pointers or version labels in an artifact registry that can be overwritten or moved to point to different binaries.
Antipattern of recompiling source code separately for each deployment environment, invalidating prior test results.
Process of advancing a verified immutable artifact to higher deployment environments after passing quality gates.
